semiconductor_relevance: High — Mipox specializes in polishing equipment and materials critical for semiconductor device testing and manufacturing.
summary: Mipox provides advanced polishing solutions and materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on improving the reliability and lifespan of probe cards and test sockets. Their proprietary polishing methods and materials support a range of substrates, ensuring high yield in subsequent processes.
